VALUE In Progress N/A DISCIPLINES Urban Planning & Design Landscape Design Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview This project provides consulting and supervision services for two commercial complexes belonging to the National Housing Company in Jeddah. BECT reviews schedules, budgets, payment documents, designs and shop drawings, monitors cost, time and quality, supervises construction and materials, reports on progress, and supports safety planning and final handover.
